refund_policy: No refunds after access is granted.
platform_values: Quality over quantity — every channel is hand-picked
No spam, no noise — just relevant content
Active communities where members actually engage

channels.name: Premium Signals

objection_responses.scam: Been running for 2 years. 200+ members. If it was a scam it wouldn't last this long.
objection_responses.expensive: Less than one bad trade. Most members make it back in the first week.
objection_responses.worth_it: Depends on how serious you are. Serious ones find it worth it.
objection_responses.free_alternatives: There are free groups — but signal quality and community engagement are completely different.
objection_responses.proof: Can't share P&L of others — privacy. But check how long we've been running.

faqs.question: Is this beginner friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes — many members started as beginners. Explanations are clear.

faqs.question: Which market?
faqs.answer: Primarily equity and options. Some crypto.

faqs.question: Can I try before paying?
faqs.answer: No free trial — but ₹999 is a low-risk way to check it out for a month.

faqs.question: Can I ask questions in the group?
faqs.answer: Yes — very active group. Members share trades, ask questions, discuss markets throughout the day.
